candidates.review_note: Any valid number must be a multiple of the LCM of allY indices. If that LCM violates anN clue, every multiple also violates it; otherwise it is the smallest valid positive number.

Unmoved plants must form a nondecreasing species sequence in their already-sorted coordinate order. Keep a longest nondecreasing subsequence, using bisect_right for equal species; every other plant can be replanted in its appropriate section.

Rotate all four rectangle corners clockwise around each center, compute their monotone-chain convex hull and shoelace area, and divide the sum of original rectangle areas by the hull area. Preserve the required space beforepercent.
Store a26-bit letter mask in a segment tree. Point replacement updates one leaf; OR over the queried interval gives exactly its set of distinct letters, counted with bit_count.

Preserve the initial winner as zero exclusions. Any other candidate must remove every smaller index to receive undecided votes; the accumulated prefix plus c then either beats the global maximum or requires additionally excluding one maximum-vote rival, whose voters make it sufficient.

A max-priority widest-path search propagates the minimum edge capacity along a route and retains the maximum such bottleneck per city. Roads are bidirectional, and output uses the source scenario andtons format.

Good numbers have only0 and1 in base3. Whenever a digit is2, carry to the next position and clear all lower digits; propagate carries. This is the smallest greater representable prefix with its minimum suffix.

Pair the left endpoint with each feasible odd-offset partner. All inner students must disappear before this pair is removed. Multiply inner and right-subinterval sequence counts and the binomial number of ways to interleave the completed left block with the right operations.

Build an Aho-Corasick automaton with terminal status inherited through failure links. Count length-M strings avoiding every known word, then subtract from26^M. This counts readable strings once even if multiple words occur or overlap.

Intersect and deduplicate letters in corresponding columns, sort each column, and enumerate their Cartesian product in lexicographic order. At most6^5 passwords exist, so direct enumeration is bounded and returnsNO beyond the end.
